model: Liebert XDC refrigerant chiller for XD systems with iCOM v4 (IntelliSlot Modbus)
equipment_type: Chiller (refrigerant chiller for Liebert XD rack cooling)
applies_to: Liebert XDC units (the compressorised refrigerant chiller that feeds Liebert XD rack and ceiling cooling modules) on the iCOM v4 controller with a Liebert IntelliSlot Modbus card.
summary: The Liebert XDC supplies pumped refrigerant to Liebert XD cooling modules. With a Liebert IntelliSlot Modbus card its iCOM controller exposes system on/off and status, pump and compressor states, supply refrigerant and external air temperatures, dew point, thresholds, per-XD-system fan, capacity and remote sensor values, and alarm bits.

addressing.note: The guide prints Modicon-style numbers: discrete inputs 1xxxx, input registers 3xxxx, holding registers 4xxxx. Its RTU example asks for holding register 40051 with start offset 50 (0x0032), so subtract 10001 / 30001 / 40001 to get the wire address. Coils are printed as plain numbers on the same scale as the discrete inputs (coil 25 sits beside status 10025), so coil n is wire address n-1.

source.title: Liebert IntelliSlot Modbus 485, Modbus IP and BACnet IP Reference Guide

notes: Source: Emerson Network Power / Liebert reference guide SL-28170 (Rev 9). Vertiv does not host this guide publicly; the linked copy is the unaltered PDF on the Contemporary Controls support site.

Scale column: 'x / 10' means the raw value is tenths (scale 0.1); '-' or blank means no scaling. Some temperature setpoints are printed without a scale while similar points use x / 10; they are transcribed exactly as printed.
Most temperatures exist twice: once in deg C and once in deg F at a different register. Only the deg C registers are listed here.

Points that the guide lists with both an input register (3xxxx) and a holding register (4xxxx) are the writable settings; we list the holding register (read/write). The same value can also be read at the matching 3xxxx input register (same offset).
Signedness is not stated in the guide. Temperature values are listed as INT16 (they can be below zero); everything else as UINT16.
Points that take two registers (date/time and schedule start/stop times, 32-bit values) are left out because the guide does not state their word order.
Event/alarm discrete inputs read 1 while the event is active ('Active on Alarm').
The 'SFA' rows in the guide (reserved/special-function points, including discrete inputs 18000-18024) are left out.

integration.summary: Read 30385-30424 for pumps, compressors, refrigerant and air temperatures and status; write 40426 to switch the XDC on/off. Per-XD-system data starts at 30444 / 40445 for system 1.
integration.enable: Fit the Liebert IntelliSlot card the guide lists for the unit's controller (for iCOM v4 units: IS-485L for Modbus 485, IS-IPBML for Modbus IP / BACnet IP) and set its Modbus address and line speed on the card.
quirks: Modicon numbering: subtract 40001 / 30001 / 10001 for the wire address.
The guide prints the XD-system blocks for systems 1, 2 and 20 only (and remote sensors 1, 2 and 4 per system); other systems follow the same layout but are not printed, so they are not listed here.
setup: RS-485 (2-wire) RTU settings for the IntelliSlot 485 card: 9600, 19200 or 38400 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
Each unit needs a unique Modbus slave address on the RS-485 line.
For Modbus IP, use the IntelliSlot Modbus IP / BACnet IP card listed for the unit's controller in the guide's compatibility table.
gotchas: Hot/cold aisle thresholds (40459-40465 etc.) are printed without a scale, unlike most other temperatures.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
